title: Bias Amplification in RAG: Poisoning Knowledge Retrieval to Steer LLMs
authors: Linlin Wang; Tianqing Zhu; Laiqiao Qin; Longxiang Gao; Wanlei Zhou
why_relevant: Proposes a poisoning attack on RAG that amplifies bias via adversarial document injection and subspace projection manipulation of retrieval, plus a dual-stage defense. Relevant to adversarial corruption and defenses in RAG.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on fairness/bias amplification rather than factual correctness, a slightly different angle than typical RAG poisoning work.
